title: Additional Work Response Windows and New-Estimate Thresholds for Customer-Pay Repairs
content:
Appendix to the Customer-Pay Repairs customer authorization terms: the two figures, by service tier, that govern additional work found once a job is under way.

| Service tier | Hours to answer an additional-work approval request | Cumulative approved additional work above which a new estimate is required (percent of the quoted total) |
|---|---|---|
| Paintless Dent Repair Service | 24 | 50 |
| Cosmetic Touch-Up Service | 24 | 50 |
| Bumper Refinish Service | 24 | 50 |
| Panel Repair Service | 48 | 50 |
| Customer-Pay Collision Service | 48 | 40 |
| Complete Refinish Service | 72 | 25 |

## Defined terms

- **Response window**: Hours the customer has to answer an additional-work approval request before it lapses as declined (integer, hours).
- **New-estimate threshold**: Cumulative approved additional work, as a percentage of the quoted total, above which further additions require a new estimate instead of an approval (percent).

## Questions on the appendix

**What does the new-estimate percentage measure?** Approved additional work counted cumulatively over the repair order, set against the quoted total of that order.

**How do the thresholds translate into amounts?** Hypothetical quoted total of 4000.00 in each case: the Customer-Pay Collision Service threshold of 40 percent is 1600.00 of cumulative approved additional work; the Complete Refinish Service threshold of 25 percent is 1000.00; the Panel Repair Service threshold of 50 percent is 2000.00.

**Which tiers allow longer than a day to answer?** Panel Repair Service and Customer-Pay Collision Service allow 48 hours and Complete Refinish Service 72 hours; the other three tiers allow 24 hours.
